editor_input.job_posting:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 

What We Do
Sony Interactive Entertainment is the company behind PlayStation. We build tools, and experiences used by players and development teams across the PlayStation ecosystem.
Our team develops and maintains a multi-platform application framework that helps internal teams build rich PlayStation user experiences. The framework combines React Native, native platform integration, reusable UI components, SDK tooling, and developer documentation.

Are You Looking For A Challenge?
We are looking for a Software Engineer to help develop, maintain, and improve the application framework powering PlayStation user experiences across multiple platforms. You will work across JavaScript/TypeScript, native platform integration, C++, build systems, and SDK packaging.
The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, real interest in framework and runtime work, and experience building reusable software such as SDKs, libraries, native modules, or cross-platform developer. Experience with React Native or Apple platforms such as iOS or macOS is a strong plus.

What You Will Be Doing
Implement, debug, and maintain application framework features across JavaScript/TypeScript and native layers.
Build and improve developer-facing APIs, native modules, framework components, and integration paths used by application teams.
Contribute to native framework code in C++.
Improve framework integration with React Native and native platform services.
Improve SDK packaging, framework templates, sample apps, documentation, and integration guides so partner teams can adopt framework capabilities with less support.
Debug issues across JavaScript, native code, build tooling, runtimes, and CI.
Maintain backward compatibility and clear versioning expectations for framework APIs.
Add tests, validation notes, and sample coverage for framework changes.
Collaborate with senior engineers, product teams, UI teams, and application teams to clarify requirements and land maintainable solutions.
Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, with an emphasis on correctness, maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
What We Are Looking For
B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
2-5+ years of professional software development experience.
Experience building libraries, SDKs, frameworks, developer tooling, native modules, or other reusable engineering platforms.
Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience.
Solid C++ fundamentals, including memory ownership, API boundaries, build/debug workflows, and performance-aware implementation.
Ability to debug across layers: JavaScript, native platform code, build systems, runtime logs, and CI output.
Strong API design judgment, including compatibility, versioning, error handling, documentation, and testability.
Comfort working in a large codebase with existing patterns and platform constraints.
Clear written communication for design notes, PR descriptions, validation results, and developer documentation.
Bonus Qualifications
Familiarity with React Native.
Experience with cross-platform SDKs or frameworks across iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, game console, or desktop platforms.
Experience writing high-performance or ABI-conscious C++ code.
Familiarity with CMake, Conan, CocoaPods, Gradle, Maven, npm, or other package and build distribution systems.
Experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins.
Experience building native UI components, focus/input systems, accessibility surfaces, performance instrumentation, or test harnesses.
Experience working with application teams as framework consumers and translating integration pain into reusable framework improvements.
 

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. 

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

 

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.

$137,300 - $205,900 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. 

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

raw_findings.claim: Sony Interactive Entertainment released 'Ghost of Yōtei' for PlayStation 5, with the announcement dated October 2, 2025.
Sony Interactive Entertainment appointed Lynn Azar as Senior Vice President, Finance, Corporate Development and Strategy in February 2025.
Sony Interactive Entertainment announced the integration of its wholly owned subsidiary SN Systems in February 2025.

SIE announced a PlayStation 27-inch Gaming Monitor with DualSense Charging Hook, featuring a QHD IPS display up to 2560x1440, HDR, VRR, and refresh rates up to 120Hz on PS5/PS5 Pro and 240Hz on compatible PC/Mac, coming to the U.S. and Japan in 2026.
SIE published a blog post on 'Empowering Families with Easy and Customizable Family Play Experiences' introducing the PlayStation Family App on September 10, 2025.

Sony's Game & Network Services segment (which includes PlayStation) generated ¥4.6857 trillion in revenue for fiscal year 2025, roughly flat year over year with only a ¥15.6 billion increase over FY2024.

A related Sony PlayStation job posting describes a team operating like 'a startup inside Sony PlayStation'—fast-moving, experimental, and highly ambitious, backed by the scale and resources of Sony Interactive Entertainment, building new mobile and web experiences for gamers to connect, discover, and play together.

A companion listing, 'Software Engineer I SDK' at Sony Interactive Entertainment, is based in San Mateo, CA and focuses on developing, maintaining, and improving the application framework.

SIE builds tools and experiences used by players and development teams across the PlayStation ecosystem, including a multi-platform application framework combining React Native, native platform integration, reusable UI components, SDK tooling, and developer documentation.

The role's estimated base pay range is $137,300–$205,900 USD, with eligibility for a top-tier benefits package including medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), and employee discounts on Sony products.

In Sony's Q2 FY2025 earnings (quarter ended September 30, 2025), monthly active users (MAUs) across all PlayStation platforms increased 3% year-over-year to 119 million accounts in September, with total quarterly play time up 1% year-on-year.
Sony executives described the PlayStation platform as continuing to demonstrate strength as the 'Best Place to Play' and the 'Best Place to Publish' during the Q2 FY2025 earnings call.

Game software and network service sales are steadily growing, with Sony expecting the trend to continue in the second half of FY2025 due to a continued shift to higher-tier network service subscriptions and contributions from first-party titles.

As of March 31, 2025, Sony Group had approximately 112,300 employees, a decrease of about 700 from the prior year, with headcount declines in the ET&S and G&NS (Game and Network Services) segments outside Japan.
Sony Interactive Entertainment has approximately 8,300 employees as of August 2026, located across six continents including North America, Europe, and Asia.
A related open role at PlayStation is a Software Engineer (SDK) position based in San Mateo, CA, with the same salary range of $137.3K to $205.9K listed for this application framework role.

PlayStation is separately hiring a Staff Software Engineer specializing in React Native and high-performance frontend development to define architecture, frameworks, and technical best practices for PlayStation's mobile and desktop user experiences.

That Staff Software Engineer role requires strong expertise in C++ with solid experience integrating JavaScript via React Native, plus expert knowledge of the Mac platform landscape and architectures.
PlayStation welcomed Haven Studios, a Montreal-based studio, to the PlayStation Studios family in 2022, with the studio's first new IP being a AAA multiplayer experience.
Sony's PlayStation platform is described in job postings as delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people worldwide.

By March 31, 2026, Sony's total employee count is projected to drop to approximately 94,900, a decrease of about 17,400 from the prior year, driven partly by structural reforms in the ET&S segment and divestitures in the I&SS segment.

checks.question: What are the specifications and release details of SIE's PlayStation 27-inch Gaming Monitor with DualSense Charging Hook?
checks.answer:
SIE (Sony Interactive Entertainment) has unveiled the PlayStation 27-inch Gaming Monitor with DualSense Charging Hook, designed for desktop PS5 gaming.

Key specifications:
- Screen type: IPS
- Screen size: 27"
- Resolution: 2560 x 1440 (QHD)
- Aspect Ratio: 16:9
- Refresh Rate: Up to 240Hz
- HDR: Yes
- Brightness: 350 cd/m²
- Contrast ratio: 1000:1
- VRR: HDMI VRR, AMD FreeSync Premium
- Color gamut: DCI-P3 95%
- External Dimensions with stand (highest position): approx. 614 x 534 x 214 mm (24.2 x 21.0 x 8.4 in) (W x H x D)
- External Dimensions without stand: approx. 614 x 364 x 69 mm (24.2 x 14.3 x 2.7 in)
- Mass with stand: approx. 6.2 kg (13.7 lb)

A standout feature is the built-in charging hook, which lets users conveniently charge a DualSense or DualSense Edge wireless controller directly on the monitor.

Release details: The monitor is set to launch in 2026 in the United States and Japan. As of the announcement (via the PlayStation Blog and PlayStation's Instagram), exact launch dates and pricing have not yet been announced — PlayStation said more information on availability would be shared in the coming months. It's also noted that HDMI/DisplayPort cables are not included, and some features require compatible devices and supported games (sold separately).
